text:
tess: dropping a small UX drop for hover previews on eval diffs + CTA placement tweak. mock: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/hover-preview-cta-v1.png

hugo: quick summary?

tess: goal: let reviewers peek diff content without opening panel. hover card shows first 3 lines, highlights regressions, and surfaces a mini-approve button. also experimenting with moving primary approve from header to a per-diff inline location for faster triage.

maya: love the peek. a11y concerns: hover-only interactions exclude keyboard/screenreader users. need a focusable trigger and explicit reveal action (Enter/Space) with `role=button` + `aria-expanded`.

tess: agreed. plan: hover triggers visual preview, keyboard focus on the row opens the same card on Enter, and card has `role=dialog` with `aria-label="Diff preview"` so assistive tech can read.

sam: microcopy: inline mini-approve copy should be clear: avoid "Quick approve" (ambiguous). use "Approve diff" and if action affects run add tooltip: "Approves this test in the current run". Also keyboard shortcut `P` for approve on focused preview.

hugo: what's the intent for the per-diff CTA versus sticky header CTA? could be confusing to have two primary actions.

tess: proposal: keep global sticky "Approve selected" for batch ops. per-diff inline CTA is for single-item fast triage and is visually lower prominence. If user selects multiple, inline CTAs are disabled.

maya: accessibility nit: when preview opens, announce summary: "Preview opened for <test name>. 2 regressions detected." Use `aria-live="polite"` region and move focus into the card. when closed, restore focus to the originating row.

sam: color/contrast: aria_bot flagged mini-approve green (#28C76F) at 3.5:1 on white when used as a primary affordance. Suggest darker #1EA64D or add solid border. Also ensure focus style visible: 3px ring and 2px gap.

aria_bot: accessibility-check: suggested mini-approve #1EA64D gives 4.6:1. If inline CTA is icon-only on narrow screens, add accessible label and 44x44 hit area. For hover previews, ensure content doesn't overlap other controls and that z-index stacking doesn't hide focus outlines.

hugo: performance: many previews could be expensive. lazy-load preview content (first request on hover/focus) and cache TTL 30s. show skeleton while loading. dev note: `fetchPreview(diffId)` debounce 200ms.

tess: good call. we'll lazy-load with 200ms debounce, cache per session. skeleton height matches 3 lines so layout doesn't jump.

maya: keyboard navigation: when a preview is opened via keyboard, Tab should move into preview controls (approve/comment/close) and Esc closes it. Announce tab key tips: small hint in footer "Tab to interact, Esc to close". Also add `aria-describedby` linking the hint.

sam: small copy point: the inline CTA tooltip when disabled should read "Disable: multiple items selected" not just "Disabled". helpful for keyboard users with tooltip on focus.

aria_bot: accessibility-check: tooltips must be accessible on focus (not just hover). Use `aria-describedby` to attach tooltip content to the control. Also avoid relying solely on color to convey regression vs changed state; include icon or text badge (e.g., "2 reg") in the preview.

hugo: analytics suggestions: `preview.open`, `preview.approve`, `preview.load_time_ms`, include `source=hover|keyboard` dimension. Also track cache hit/miss.

tess: action items: (tess) update mock with darker mini-approve and tooltip copy (2244445568), (sam) add skeleton + debounce + cache doc, (maya) prototype keyboard focus/reveal with `aria-live` messages and restore-focus behavior, (hugo) add analytics enums. I'll include a short HTML prototype in the PR for screenreader testing. Thanks :thumbsup:
